title: APTInvestBench: Evaluating Autonomous APT Investigation under Varying Telemetry
abstract: arXiv:2609.38954v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents could help security operations centers (SOCs) investigate advanced persistent threats (APTs) by turning weak leads into evidence for intrusion scoping and response. Yet success under one telemetry setting does not establish robustness to changes in log collection, retention, or sampling. We introduce APTInvestBench, a benchmark for evaluating cross-telemetry robustness in autonomous APT investigation. It comprises 370 cases across seven SOC-inspired conditions, derived from 56 report-informed attack reconstructions with 16.4 million log records. Agents investigate unverified leads and submit reports with record-level citations. Fixed action-level support requirements track sufficient evidence across available logs, query returns, and formal citations, separating telemetry limitations from acquisition and reporting gaps. translated_title: APTInvestBench：在不同遥测条件下评估自主APT调查
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体可以通过将微弱的线索转化为用于入侵范围界定和响应的证据，帮助安全运营中心（SOC）调查高级持续性威胁（APT）。然而，在某一遥测设置下的成功并不能证明其对日志收集、保留或采样变化具有鲁棒性。我们提出了APTInvestBench，一个用于评估自主APT调查中跨遥测鲁棒性的基准。该基准包含370个案例，涵盖七种受SOC启发的条件，源自56个基于报告的攻击重建，共涉及1640万条日志记录。智能体对未经验证的线索进行调查，并提交带有记录级引用的报告。固定的动作级证据支持要求用于追踪在可用日志、查询返回和正式引用中的充分证据，从而将遥测本身的限制与证据获取和报告方面的差距区分开来。在十一个LLM的测试中，智能体仅为44.3%的可恢复攻击获取了充分证据……
tldr: APTInvestBench是一个评估LLM智能体在不同遥测条件下自主调查APT的跨遥测鲁棒性的基准，包含七种SOC场景下的370个案例和1640万条日志记录，测试显示十一个LLM仅为44.3%的可恢复攻击获取了充分证据。
en_tdlr: APTInvestBench is a benchmark for evaluating the cross-telemetry robustness of LLM agents in autonomous APT investigation, comprising 370 cases across seven SOC-inspired conditions with 16.4 million log records, and reveals that agents across eleven LLMs acquire sufficient evidence for only 44.3% of recoverable attacks.
